definitions.explanation: The large intestine — the final section of the digestive tract, which absorbs water and forms waste. Contrasts with the {小腸|しょうちょう} (small intestine).

examples.japanese: {大腸|だいちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{大腸|だいちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸収|きゅうしゅう}する→吸収する：25365_kyuushuusuru⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The large intestine functions to absorb water.

examples.japanese: {四十歳|よんじゅっさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧{大腸|だいちょう}がん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: After turning forty, I was advised to get screened for colon cancer.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大腸|だいちょう}がん: colon cancer
- {大腸|だいちょう}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: colon examination
- {大腸|だいちょう}{菌|きん}: coliform bacteria; E. coli

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小腸|しょうちょう}: small intestine — the section before the large intestine, where most nutrients are absorbed.
